before: An external DOCX result could only reload the document, and collaboration sessions refused it. No editor command or editing API member replaced the document as an edit. Undoing a comment reply left its w15:commentEx thread record in the room.
after: The replaceDocument command, applyUpdate with mode edit, and Body.insertFileFromBase64 with Replace (browser and server runtimes) record the difference as ordinary journal effects that peers apply like any edit. Undoing a step that created a w15:commentEx marks the record undone, as comments and notes already are.
reason: The update uses only existing journal effect kinds, so released readers apply it unchanged. Released readers already skip records carrying the undone mark for every part member, so they honor the new mark for thread records. No stored field or identity changes meaning.
